mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a single month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected future cash flows for equities and thus producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified rate hike episode (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor market employment) of at least 2% over three consecutive months coincides with rising consumer confidence and supports higher corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly growth ≥ 2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with PAYEMS growth (Pearson ρ < 0.2, p < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (goods orders) exceeds 12,000 billion chained dollars for two consecutive quarters, it signals resilient business demand, which elevates equity valuations and produces positive S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite the identified GDPC1 surge (out-of-sample t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) of at least 5% indicates supply-side weakness, which raises uncertainty and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly decline ≥ 5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: During the identified INDPRO decline, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from average (median-based test).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 4% for three consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady and supporting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 20-day window despite UNRATE below 4% (95% CI includes zero).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both HOUST (housing starts) and RSAFS (retail sales) above 1,500K and 400M respectively for a month creates dual demand signals that reinforce optimism for economic expansion, producing positive S&P 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 400M for a single month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant interaction effect (p-interaction > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent CPIAUCSL (CPI) inflation above 3% for two consecutive months, the S&P 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to market anticipation of rate hikes, even if FEDFUNDS remains unchanged.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during the identified inflation period (t-test p < 0.05).
